_comment: Google News search queries for countries without a local edition, where the plain name would be ambiguous or misspelt. Countries not listed use their full name in quotes. Codes listed under skip get no feed at all.

queries.GE: "Georgia" (Tbilisi OR Georgian OR Kobakhidze OR "Georgian Dream") -Atlanta -Bulldogs -"Georgia Tech" -"secretary of state" -Kemp -Savannah
queries.JO: "Jordan" (Amman OR Jordanian OR Hashemite OR "King Abdullah")
queries.CD: "DR Congo" OR "Democratic Republic of the Congo" OR Kinshasa
queries.CG: "Republic of the Congo" OR "Congo-Brazzaville" OR Brazzaville
queries.PS: Palestine OR Palestinian OR Gaza OR "West Bank"
